spots.text: Curled up on the porch steps, exactly where you need to walk.
On the farmhouse roof. Nobody knows how she got up there. Nobody will ever know.
Sitting next to the chimney like a tiny gargoyle.
Flat on the welcome mat. Welcome to Luna.
Inside the well bucket. Do not lower the bucket.
In the kitchen window, judging everyone.
On the kitchen roof, soaking up the warmth from the stove.
Stretched across a garden row like she planted herself.
In the clean laundry basket. It is no longer clean.
Sitting on the Almanac. Absorbing the knowledge.
Napping in the flower bed, squishing the petunias.
In the wheelbarrow. Expects to be pushed around.
On top of the coop. The hens are not amused.
In a nesting box. She did not lay an egg. She is offended you checked.
Inside the feed bin, among the chicken scratch.
Up in the apple tree, very pleased with herself.
On the top step of the orchard ladder.
Balanced on a single fence post. Somehow.
On the barn roof, next to the weathervane.
Peeking out of the hayloft door.
Asleep on top of a Highland cow. The cow seems fine with it.
On the edge of the water trough. Dangerously close to a bath.
Curled up in an empty milk pail.
On a hay bale, looking like a loaf.
In the exact middle of the pasture. The cows walk around her.
In the old tractor seat, ready to drive (she cannot drive).
On the market stall table. Not for sale. Probably.
On top of the market stall canopy.
On top of the honor box, guarding the coins.
On top of the mailbox. The mail carrier has learned to work around her.
On the hood of Claire's delivery van. Warm engine, warm cat.
Under the road sign, waiting for a ride to nowhere.
Inside an empty wine barrel. Do not start fermenting.
On the winery roof, overseeing the vines.
Between the berry rows, purple paws.
In a crate of empty bottles. Every bottle has a cat in it now.
Under the arbor, in a sunbeam.
On a greenhouse shelf among the seedlings. It is warm in there.
On the greenhouse roof. Bold choice.
Sitting on the scarecrow's shoulder. The crows are confused.
Lying in a furrow, perfectly camouflaged as a lump of dirt.
On a mossy rock in the creek. Keeping her paws very dry.
On a fallen log, staring at a frog. The frog stares back.
On the creek bank, listening to the water.
On a big tree stump in Selleck Woods, looking majestic.
Hidden in a fern patch. Only her tail is visible.
Inside a hollow log, like a little forest witch.
In the middle of the South Field. Long walk for a nap.
Walking along the top of the south fence like a tightrope.
Curled up in the pumpkin pile, matching nothing.
In her own cat bed! Just kidding, she is next to it, on the floor.
Inside one of your boots. Good luck putting those on.
On the firewood stack, the warmest log.

gifts.desc: From the winery floor. She is a collector.

gifts.name: Perfect Leaf
gifts.desc: The best leaf. She looked at a lot of leaves.

gifts.name: Your Hair Tie
gifts.desc: You have been looking for this for a week.

gifts.name: One Sock
gifts.desc: The other sock is gone forever.

gifts.name: Tiny Bell
gifts.desc: Possibly from a cow collar. No one is asking questions.

gifts.name: Pinecone
gifts.desc: From Selleck Woods. She went on an adventure.
